    48→fun pre_liquidation_check<MarketType>(
    49→    app: &ProtocolApp,
    50→    cap: &PackageCallerCap,
    51→    market: &Market<MarketType>,
    52→    permission: u8,
    53→) {
    54→    app.validate_market<MarketType>(market);
    55→    app.ensure_version_matches();
    56→
    57→    app.ensure_has_permission(object::id(cap), permission);
    58→
    59→    assert!(!market.has_circuit_break_triggered(), protocol::error::market_under_circuit_break());
    60→}
    61→
    62→fun post_liquidation<MarketType, DebtType, CollateralType>(
    63→    now: u64,
    64→    repay_amount: u64,
    65→    refund_amount: u64,
    66→    liquidation_type: LiquidationType,
    67→
    68→    obligation_id: ID,
    69→    market: &mut Market<MarketType>,
    70→
    71→    collateral_amount: u64,
    72→    ctoken_amount: u64,
    73→
    74→    x_oracle: &XOracle,
    75→    clock: &Clock,
    76→    ctx: &TxContext,
    77→) {
    78→    let debt_type = type_name::with_defining_ids<DebtType>();
    79→    let collateral_type = type_name::with_defining_ids<CollateralType>();
    80→
    81→    let obligation = market.borrow_obligation(obligation_id);
    82→    let oracle = market.emode_registry().borrow_emode_group(obligation.emode_group()).get_oracle_base_token();
    83→
    84→    let total_ctoken_amount = obligation.ctoken_amount_by_coin(collateral_type);
    85→    let (total_borrow, borrow_index) = if (obligation.has_debt(debt_type)) {
    86→        let debt = obligation.debt(debt_type);
    87→        (debt.unsafe_debt_amount(), *debt.borrow_index())
    88→    }  else {
    89→        (math::float::zero(), math::float::one())
    90→    };

    97→        clock
